paper_id: GPT as Psychologist_ Preliminary Evaluations for GPT-4V on Visual Affective Computing
title: GPT as Psychologist? Preliminary Evaluations for GPT-4V on Visual Affective Computing
motivation: 缺乏评估多模态大语言模型在情感计算任务上表现的标准基准
problem_framing: 在5项关键能力上系统评估GPT-4V的视觉情感计算能力
key_insight: 利用链式推理将表情识别转化为AU识别可提升准确率
method_signature: 多问题类型(开闭式/判断/选择)+多数据集(DISFA/RAF-DB等)的定性定量混合评估
evaluation_criteria: AU检测用F1分数，其余任务用定性分析
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: GPT-4V在微表情识别上无法理解帧间差异，在欺骗检测上无法正确推理
evidence_for_taste: GPT-4V cannot understand the difference between frames
GPT-4V is still challenging for subjective tasks
cannot achieve good performance on the subjective task
this is because emotions are inherently difficult to recognize without context
the model to first recognize the specific AU representation and then deduce the emotion
thinking_moves: 把感知问题frame成交流问题——认为情感识别失败是因为缺乏上下文交流语境
先证AU识别能力再反推表情：用已知强项补弱势
从失败案例归纳出「客观vs主观」任务分野的认知框架
